context: Tests manual checkpoint-and-fork using Koog 1.3 Persistence with automatic saving disabled. The snapshot module supplies Persistence; there is no separate Snapshot feature or runFromSnapshot API.

checklist.name: Configures manual Persistence with a real provider
checklist.description: Installs ai.koog.agents.snapshot.feature.Persistence with a concrete in-memory or durable storage provider and enableAutomaticPersistence=false for explicit save points. Does not invent install(Snapshot).

checklist.name: Adds the agents-features-snapshot dependency
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-features-snapshot:1.3.0 to build.gradle.kts; a durable backend dependency that brings this module transitively is also valid.

checklist.name: Creates a checkpoint at the decision point
checklist.description: Uses withPersistence and createCheckpointAfterNode at the named graph decision point, passing the context, its executionInfo.path(), serialized output type and version; retains the returned AgentCheckpointData. Does not invent snapshot().

checklist.name: Replays two independent checkpoint branches
checklist.description: Calls Persistence.runFromCheckpoint twice from the same saved prefix with distinct sessions and explicit per-branch continuation values, for example copies of graphProperties.lastOutput. Changing only the input argument does not replace restored lastOutput. Does not invent agent.runFromSnapshot or additionalInput parameters.

checklist.name: Notes serializability requirement
checklist.description: Explains that node outputs and typed storage must serialize successfully and custom data classes need a supported serializer. Uses matching graph/node names and notes that replay does not undo external side effects.
